name: The bell test
win: take a bell (touch the sensei's belt) with a teammate taking the other: hit them while staggered, bound, possessed or in genjutsu

phases.name: Reading a book
phases.behaviour: dodges everything 90%; counters with a light shove; ignores you if you only attack alone
phases.openings: a squad combo or a teammate's distraction makes it drop to 30% dodge for 60 ticks

phases.name: Lesson
phases.behaviour: when a bell is touched: Headhunter on the one who did not help

notes: Unwinnable alone by design; teaches squad commands and parry. Health never matters (hp 99x)
